title: Dubai Mainland Commercial License — DET (DED)
body: Dubai mainland commercial licenses are issued by Dubai Economy and Tourism (DET, formerly DED). Since Federal Decree-Law No. 32 of 2021, 100% foreign ownership is permitted for most commercial activities. A physical office and Ejari registration are mandatory. The license is annual and must be renewed before expiry. As of 2026, 100% foreign ownership is available for more than 1,000 commercial and industrial activities.

title: Dubai Mainland Professional License
body: The professional license covers services based on intellectual or artistic skill: consulting, accounting, IT services, legal, marketing and architecture. A Civil Company or LLC structure is used. A physical office and Ejari registration are mandatory. As of 2026, 100% foreign ownership is permitted for most professional activities.

title: Abu Dhabi Mainland License — ADDED
body: Abu Dhabi mainland licenses are issued by the Abu Dhabi Department of Economic Development (ADDED). An LLC requires a notarized MOA, a physical office and activities selected from the ADDED-approved activity catalogue. As of 2026, 100% foreign ownership is permitted for most commercial activities.

title: Dubai Free Zone — Software & Technology License
body: Software and technology license in Dubai free zones (DMCC, IFZA, Meydan, DSO, DIC and others). 100% foreign ownership, free profit repatriation and customs exemption. Selling directly to the local UAE market requires an additional permit or a local distributor. A flexi-desk or physical office is optional. The license is annual and must be renewed.

title: Dubai Free Zone — Consulting License
body: Free zone license for consulting activities, offered by zones such as IFZA, Meydan and DMCC. Well suited to serving overseas clients; direct sales within the UAE are restricted. Requires annual renewal and a KYC update.

title: DMCC — Commodities Trading License
body: DMCC (Dubai Multi Commodities Centre) issues licenses for commodities trading, crypto and related services. 100% foreign ownership and free profit repatriation. DMCC applies its own penalty schedule for late renewal: AED 0 within 30 days, AED 2,500 for 31-60 days, AED 5,000 for 61-90 days, and license cancellation after 90 days.

title: ADGM — Financial Services License
body: Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM) has its own regulatory framework for finance, fintech and related professional services. English common law applies. 100% foreign ownership and free profit repatriation.

title: UAE Regional Headquarters (RHQ) License
body: Special license for multinational companies establishing a regional headquarters. Available in Dubai or Abu Dhabi. Offers tax incentives and 100% foreign ownership. Requires operations in at least 2 GCC countries.
